info.title: Valyu API
info.description:
The search API built for AI agents. One API that gives your AI unified access to web search, academic papers, financial data, SEC filings, clinical trials, patents, genomics, and 40+ proprietary data sources.

## Products

| Product | Endpoint | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Search** | `POST /v1/search` | Multi-source search across web and proprietary datasets |
| **Contents** | `POST /v1/contents` | Extract clean, structured content from URLs |
| **Answer** | `POST /v1/answer` | AI-powered answers with real-time search |
| **DeepResearch** | `POST /v1/deepresearch/tasks` | Async research agents for comprehensive analysis |
| **Workflows** (Beta) | `GET /v1/workflows` | Templated, versioned DeepResearch for repeatable knowledge work |
| **Datasources** | `GET /v1/datasources` | Discover available data sources and their schemas |

## Authentication

All endpoints require an API key passed via the `X-API-Key` header (the lowercase `x-api-key` form is also accepted). Get your key at [platform.valyu.ai](https://platform.valyu.ai).

```
X-API-Key: your_api_key_here
```

## Pricing

Valyu uses transparent, pay-per-use pricing. Credits are shared across every API.
- **Search**: CPM-based (cost per mille tokens retrieved)
- **Contents**: $0.001 per URL extracted, +$0.001 with AI features
- **Answer**: $0.10 per request + variable search and AI costs
- **DeepResearch**: Fixed per-task pricing by mode ($0.10 - $15.00)

All plans include web search and open academic sources. A subscription unlocks specialised and proprietary sources (SEC filings, patents, drug discovery, genomics, and more) at a lower cost per credit. See [docs.valyu.ai](https://docs.valyu.ai) for full pricing details.

## SDKs

- [Python SDK](https://pypi.org/project/valyu/) - `pip install valyu`
- [TypeScript SDK](https://www.npmjs.com/package/valyu) - `npm install valyu`

tags.name: Search
tags.description: Search across web, academic, financial, and proprietary data sources. Returns results ready for RAG pipelines, AI agents, and applications.

tags.name: Contents
tags.description: Extract clean, structured content from web pages at scale. Supports batch processing, AI-powered summaries, structured extraction via JSON schemas, and async jobs for large URL sets.

tags.name: Answer
tags.description: Get AI-powered answers grounded in real-time search results. The Answer API searches across web, academic, and financial sources, then uses AI to generate a readable response via Server-Sent Events streaming.

tags.name: DeepResearch
tags.description: Async research agents that perform comprehensive, multi-step research. DeepResearch searches multiple sources, analyzes content, and generates detailed reports with citations. Tasks run in the background and can take minutes to complete.

tags.name: Batches
tags.description: Run multiple DeepResearch tasks in parallel with shared configuration, unified monitoring, and aggregated cost tracking.

tags.name: Workflows
tags.description: **Beta.** Templated, versioned DeepResearch for repeatable knowledge work - earnings previews, diligence reads, market sizings. A workflow bundles a prompt template with typed variables, a research strategy, report format, deliverables, tools, and a recommended mode. Workflows are immutably versioned; runs can pin a version. Two scopes exist: your organization's private workflows and curated Valyu workflows available to everyone. Run a workflow by passing `workflow_id` + `workflow_params` to `POST /v1/deepresearch/tasks` - same auth, billing, and task lifecycle as freeform DeepResearch.

tags.name: Datasources
tags.description: Discover available data sources and their schemas. A tool manifest for AI agents - instead of hardcoding knowledge of available datasets, agents can query this API to discover sources, filter by category, and use `example_queries` for few-shot prompting.

post.summary: Search across web and proprietary data sources
post.description:
Search the web, academic journals, financial databases, and 40+ proprietary data sources. Returns ranked results with extracted content, ready for RAG pipelines and AI agents.

Results are ranked by relevance using semantic reranking (unless `fast_mode` is enabled). You only pay for results returned - pricing is CPM-based (cost per mille tokens).

**Integrating search into an agent?** Consider [DeepResearch](https://docs.valyu.ai/guides/deepresearch) - a cost-effective autonomous agent built on top of this search engine, purpose-built for knowledge work.

post.summary: Extract clean, structured content from URLs
post.description:
Turn any web page into clean, structured data. Extract content from up to 10 URLs per request with optional AI-powered summaries, structured extraction via JSON schemas, and screenshot capture.

- **Synchronous (default)**: Returns extracted content directly
- **Async**: Set `async: true` to process in the background and poll a `job_id`
- **Pay-per-success**: Only charged for URLs that are successfully processed ($0.001/URL, +$0.001 with AI features). Failed URLs are free
- **Partial / total failure**: A `206` is returned when some URLs fail; a `422` is returned when every URL fails

post.summary: Get AI-powered answers with real-time search
post.description:
Searches across web, academic, and financial sources, then uses AI to generate a readable, cited response. Returns results as a **Server-Sent Events (SSE)** stream.

The AI agent performs multi-round search with up to 2 tool call rounds (3 in `fast_mode`), can decompose queries into sub-queries, and synthesizes findings into a coherent answer.

## SSE Event Types

Events are sent as `data: {json}\n\n` with the following types:

| Event | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `search_results` | Search sources found (may occur multiple times) |
| `content` | Partial answer text chunk (OpenAI-compatible delta format) |
| `metadata` | Final metadata with costs, token usage, and all search results |
| `[DONE]` | Stream complete |

## Cost Structure

Each request costs a base of ~$0.10 plus variable search and AI token costs. The `cost` object in the metadata event provides a full breakdown.

value.query: What are the latest FDA-approved treatments for type 2 diabetes?
Compare the top 5 electric vehicles by range and price in 2024
SEC enforcement actions against crypto exchanges
value.system_instructions: You are a financial regulatory analyst. Focus on enforcement actions and penalties.

200.description: SSE stream of search results, answer chunks, and metadata.

schema.description:
Server-Sent Events stream. Each event has format: `data: {json}\n\n`

**search_results event:**
```json
{"search_results": [{"title": "...", "url": "...", "content": "...", ...}]}
```

**content event (OpenAI-compatible):**
```json
{"choices": [{"delta": {"role": "assistant", "content": "text chunk"}, "index": 0}]}
```

**metadata event:**
```json
{"success": true, "tx_id": "ai_tx_...", "data_type": "unstructured", "search_results": [...], "search_metadata": {"tx_ids": [...], "number_of_results": 10, "total_characters": 50000}, "ai_usage": {"input_tokens": 15000, "output_tokens": 2000}, "cost": {"total_deduction_dollars": 0.15, "search_deduction_dollars": 0.03, "ai_deduction_dollars": 0.10, "contents_deduction_dollars": 0.02}}
```

**done signal:**
```
data: [DONE]
```

ApiKeyAuth.name: X-API-Key
ApiKeyAuth.description: API key for authentication. Get yours at [platform.valyu.ai](https://platform.valyu.ai).

error.description: Human-readable error message describing what went wrong.

query.description: The search query to execute. Supports natural language queries.

max_num_results.description: Maximum number of results to return. Higher limits (up to 100) available on request.

search_type.description:
Controls which data sources are searched.

- `all` - Web and proprietary sources (default). An LLM router selects the best sources for your query.
- `web` - Web search only. Best for current events and general topics.
- `proprietary` - Academic, financial, and premium sources only. Best for research and technical analysis.
- `news` - News articles only. Best for recent news and current events.

max_price.description: Maximum budget in CPM (cost per mille/thousand tokens). When not set, automatically calculated based on `max_num_results` and `search_type`.

relevance_threshold.description: Minimum relevance score (0.0-1.0) for results after reranking. Results below this threshold are filtered out.

included_sources.description:
Sources to include in the search. Accepts:
- Domain names or URLs for web filtering (e.g. `"arxiv.org"`, `"https://arxiv.org"`)
- Dataset identifiers for proprietary sources (e.g. `"valyu/valyu-arxiv"`)
- Preset names that expand to curated source groups: `"academic"`, `"finance"`, `"patent"`, `"transportation"`, `"politics"`, `"legal"`, `"health"`, `"genomics"`, `"chemistry"`, `"physics"`
- `"web"` keyword to explicitly include web search alongside proprietary sources
- `"collection:NAME"` to reference an org-scoped saved source collection

Note: most specialised and proprietary sources require a subscription. All plans include web search and open academic sources (arXiv, PubMed).

excluded_sources.description: Sources to exclude from the search. Same format as `included_sources` except presets are not supported.

source_biases.description: Bias values for specific sources to influence ranking without hard filtering. Keys are domains (e.g., 'nasa.gov') or URL paths (e.g., 'nih.gov/research'). Values are integers from -5 (strong demotion) to +5 (strong boost). Most specific path match wins.

instructions.description: Natural language instructions to help rank results by relevance to user intent. Acts as a system prompt for the search. Max 500 characters. Ignored when fast_mode is true.
instructions.example: Focus on oncology clinical trials from 2023 onwards

category.description: **Deprecated.** Use `instructions` instead. Falls back to this value if `instructions` is not set.

is_tool_call.description: Indicates whether this request originates from an AI tool call. Affects query rewriting behavior.

response_length.description:
Controls the maximum character length of content per result.

- `"short"` - 25,000 characters (default)
- `"medium"` - 50,000 characters
- `"large"` - 100,000 characters
- `"max"` - No limit
- Any positive integer for a custom character limit

start_date.description: Filter results published on or after this date. Format: `YYYY-MM-DD`. If set without `end_date`, defaults to today.

end_date.description: Filter results published on or before this date. Format: `YYYY-MM-DD`. If set without `start_date`, defaults to `1900-01-01`.

country_code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code for geo-targeted web search results.

fast_mode.description: Bypass LLM query rewriting and reranking for lower latency. Forces web-only search. Cannot be used with `search_type: "proprietary"`.

url_only.description: Return only URLs without full content extraction. Only available when `search_type` is `"web"` or `"news"`. Skips reranking.

historical_cache.description: Allow results to be served from the historical cache when available. Useful for reproducible queries and lower latency.

SearchResult.description: A single search result with extracted content.

id.description: Unique identifier for this result (typically the URL).

title.example: Quantum Computing Breakthrough: New Error Correction Method

content.description: Extracted text content in markdown format, truncated to `response_length`.
content.example: Researchers at MIT have developed a revolutionary quantum error correction method...

description.description: Short description or meta summary of the document.
description.example: Major breakthrough in quantum error correction methodology

source.description: Source identifier. `"web"` for web results, or a proprietary source name.

price.description: Cost in USD for this individual result.

image_url.description: Image URLs associated with this result, keyed by index. `null` if no images.

relevance_score.description: Relevance score from reranking (0.0-1.0). Higher is more relevant.

source_type.description:
Classification of the source.

- `website` - General web page
- `forum` - Forum or discussion thread
- `paper` - Academic paper
- `data` - Structured data source
- `report` - Report or analysis
- `health_data` - Healthcare data
- `clinical_trial` - Clinical trial record
- `drug_label` - FDA drug label
- `grants` - Research grant

publication_date.description: Publication date in `YYYY-MM-DD` format, or empty string if unknown.

metadata.description: Additional structured metadata (financial and specialized results only).

SearchResponse.description: Search response containing results and metadata.

error.description: Error or warning message. May be non-empty even on successful responses if some sources had issues.

tx_id.description: Transaction ID for tracking and support.

results_by_source.description: Count of results broken down by source type.

total_deduction_dollars.description: Total cost charged for this search in USD.

total_characters.description: Sum of all result content lengths in characters.

warnings.description: Warning messages, if any (e.g. collection resolution warnings). Only present when warnings exist.

urls.description: URLs to extract content from. Must be valid HTTP/HTTPS URLs. Duplicates are silently removed.

response_length.description:
Maximum character length of extracted content per URL.

- `"short"` - 25,000 characters (default)
- `"medium"` - 50,000 characters
- `"large"` - 100,000 characters
- `"max"` - No limit
- Any positive integer for a custom character limit

max_price_dollars.description: Maximum budget in USD for this request. If estimated cost exceeds this, the request is rejected. Defaults to 2x the maximum possible cost.

summary.description:
Controls AI-powered content processing. Adds $0.001 per URL when enabled.

- `false` - No AI processing, raw extracted content only (default)
- `true` - Generate a text summary of each page
- `"string"` - Generate a summary guided by custom instructions (max 500 characters)
- `{json_schema}` - Extract structured data matching the provided JSON schema

oneOf.description: JSON Schema for structured extraction. Supports types: object, array, string, number, integer, boolean.

extract_effort.description:
Controls how pages are rendered for extraction.

- `"auto"` - Automatically selects the best method per URL (default)
- `"normal"` - HTTP-only extraction, fastest
- `"high"` - Full Chrome rendering, best for JavaScript-heavy pages

screenshot.description: Capture a screenshot of each page. Screenshot URL returned in `screenshot_url` field of each result.

async.description: Process URLs asynchronously in the background. Returns a `job_id` to poll via `GET /v1/contents/jobs/{job_id}`. Useful for slow, JavaScript-heavy pages.

webhook_url.description: HTTPS URL to receive a webhook POST when async processing completes. Only used when `async` is `true`. The webhook payload is signed with HMAC-SHA256.

ContentResult.description: Extracted content from a single URL.

content.description: Extracted content. Markdown string when `data_type` is `"unstructured"`, JSON object when `data_type` is `"structured"`. Present when `status` is `"success"`.

oneOf.description: Structured data matching the provided JSON schema.

content.example:
# Quantum computing

Quantum computing is a type of computation...

description.example: Quantum computing is a type of computation that harnesses quantum mechanical phenomena.

source.description: `"web"` for web pages, or the dataset id for academic papers served from Valyu's processed index (e.g. `valyu/valyu-arxiv`, `valyu/valyu-pubmed`, `valyu/valyu-biorxiv`, `valyu/valyu-medrxiv`, `valyu/valyu-chemrxiv`).

price.description: Cost in USD for extracting this URL.

data_type.description: `"unstructured"` for text content, `"structured"` when JSON schema extraction succeeded.

source_type.description: Classification of the content type. `"paper"` for academic papers served from the processed index.

publication_date.description: Publication date in `YYYY-MM-DD` format, or empty string if unknown.

id.description: Identifier for this result. The URL for web pages, or the bare paper id / DOI for academic papers (e.g. `2506.05440`, `10.26434/chemrxiv-2025-chn4j`).

image_url.description: Image URLs found on the page, keyed by index.

screenshot_url.description: Screenshot URL if `screenshot` was enabled. `null` otherwise.

summary.description: AI-generated summary or structured extraction result. Only present when `summary` was enabled in the request.

summary_success.description: Whether AI processing succeeded. Only present when `summary` was enabled.

structured_metadata.description: Metadata from structured data extraction. Only present when `data_type` is `"structured"`.

error.description: Human-readable failure reason. Only present when `status` is `"failed"`. Describes why extraction failed without exposing internal infrastructure.
error.example: Could not extract content from this URL. The page may be unavailable, require sign-in, or block automated access.

doi.description: Paper DOI. Present for academic papers served from the processed index.

authors.description: Paper authors. Present for academic papers served from the processed index.

citation_count.description: Citation count. Present for academic papers served from the processed index.

error.description: Error message if some URLs failed. `null` on complete success.

urls_failed.description: Number of URLs that failed processing.

total_cost_dollars.description: Total cost in USD (only successful URLs are charged).

total_characters.description: Sum of all result content lengths.

ContentsAsyncResponse.description: Response returned when async processing is initiated.

success.description: Whether the async job was created successfully.

urls_total.description: Total number of URLs queued for processing.

poll_url.description: Relative URL to poll for job status.

webhook_secret.description: HMAC-SHA256 secret for verifying webhook payloads. Only present when `webhook_url` was provided.

job_id.description: Unique identifier for the async job.

status.description:
Current job status.

- `pending` - Job created, not yet started
- `processing` - URLs are being processed
- `completed` - All URLs processed successfully
- `partial` - Processing finished with some failures
- `failed` - All URLs failed

urls_total.description: Total number of URLs to process.

urls_processed.description: Number of URLs successfully processed so far.

urls_failed.description: Number of URLs that failed processing.

created_at.description: Job creation time as Unix timestamp in milliseconds.

updated_at.description: Last update time as Unix timestamp in milliseconds.

current_batch.description: Current batch being processed. Only present when `status` is `"processing"`.

total_batches.description: Total number of batches. Only present when `status` is `"processing"`.

results.description: Extraction results. Only present when `status` is `"completed"` or `"partial"`.

actual_cost_dollars.description: Total cost in USD. Only present when processing is complete.

error.description: Error message. Only present when `status` is `"failed"` or `"partial"`.

query.description: The question or research query to answer.
query.example: What are the latest FDA-approved treatments for type 2 diabetes?

search_type.description:
Controls which data sources are searched.

- `all` - Web and proprietary sources (default)
- `web` - Web search only
- `proprietary` - Academic, financial, and premium sources only
- `news` - News articles only

included_sources.description: Sources to include. Accepts domains, URLs, dataset identifiers, or presets (`"finance"`, `"medical"`).

excluded_sources.description: Sources to exclude. Same format as `included_sources` except presets are not supported.

data_max_price.description: Maximum budget in USD for the search data component. Converted to CPM internally.

start_date.description: Filter results published on or after this date. Format: `YYYY-MM-DD`.

end_date.description: Filter results published on or before this date. Format: `YYYY-MM-DD`.

country_code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code for geo-targeted search.

fast_mode.description: Enable fast mode for lower latency. Uses 3 tool call rounds instead of 2 and higher result counts per query.

structured_output.description: JSON Schema defining the desired output structure. When set, the AI returns a JSON object matching this schema instead of free-form text. Max depth 10, max 50 properties, max 5000 characters.

system_instructions.description: Custom system instructions for the AI. Replaces the default research agent prompt. Max 2000 characters.
system_instructions.example: You are a medical research assistant. Cite all sources.

search_type.description: Controls which data sources are searched.

source_biases.description: Bias values for specific sources to influence ranking (-5 to +5). Applied to every search call during research.

start_date.description: Filter results from this date. Format: `YYYY-MM-DD`.

end_date.description: Filter results until this date. Format: `YYYY-MM-DD`. Must be >= `start_date`.

FileAttachment.description: A file to include in the research task.

data.description: File content as a data URL. Format: `data:<mediaType>;base64,<base64data>`.

context.description: Optional context about the file to guide the research agent. Maximum 10,000 characters.

DeepResearchCreateRequest.description:
Request to create a DeepResearch task.

A task can be either **freeform** (provide `query`/`input` plus optional `research_strategy`, `report_format`, etc.) or **workflow-driven** (provide `workflow_id` + `workflow_params`). The two modes are mutually exclusive: passing `workflow_id` alongside freeform fields (`query`, `input`, `research_strategy`, `report_format`) returns `400 workflow_and_freeform_mutually_exclusive`. When running a workflow, any `mode`/`deliverables`/`tools` you pass in the body override the template defaults.

query.description: The research query or question. Use `query` (preferred) or `input` (deprecated). Maximum 25,000 characters. Mutually exclusive with `workflow_id`.
query.example: Comprehensive analysis of CRISPR gene therapy clinical trials in 2024

workflow_id.description: **Beta.** Slug of a workflow to run instead of a freeform query. When set, the task is resolved from the workflow's prompt template using `workflow_params`. Mutually exclusive with freeform fields (`query`, `input`, `research_strategy`, `report_format`); supplying both returns `400 workflow_and_freeform_mutually_exclusive`. See the [Workflows](#tag/Workflows) endpoints.

workflow_params.description: **Beta.** Values for the workflow's template variables, keyed by variable `key`. Required when `workflow_id` is set. Values must satisfy the workflow's declared variable types and validation rules.

workflow_version.description: **Beta.** Pin the run to a specific immutable version of the workflow. Defaults to the workflow's current version when omitted. Only valid with `workflow_id`.

mode.description:
Research mode controlling depth and cost.

| Mode | Price | Best For | Max Steps |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `fast` | $0.10 | Quick queries, batch processing | 10 |
| `standard` | $0.50 | Balanced research | 15 |
| `heavy` | $2.50 | Complex topics requiring deep analysis | 15 |
| `max` | $15.00 | Exhaustive research with maximum quality | 25 |

strategy.description: **Deprecated.** Use `research_strategy` instead. Natural language strategy to guide the research agent's approach.
strategy.example: Focus on Phase 3 trials and compare efficacy data across studies

research_strategy.description: Natural language strategy to guide the research phase. Controls how the agent searches, what sources to prioritize, and research methodology. Combined length of `research_strategy` and `report_format` must not exceed 15,000 characters.
research_strategy.example: Focus on Phase 3 trials and compare efficacy data across studies

report_format.description: Natural language instructions for the output format. Has highest priority and overrides default formatting. Controls structure, style, length, and presentation of the final report. Combined length of `research_strategy` and `report_format` must not exceed 15,000 characters.
report_format.example: Write a 2-page executive summary with bullet points and a comparison table

urls.description: URLs to include in the research context. Max 10.

files.description: Files to analyze as part of the research. Max 10.

output_formats.description:
Desired output formats. Defaults to `["markdown"]`.

- `"markdown"` - Markdown report (default)
- `"pdf"` - PDF document (can combine with `"markdown"`)
- `"toon"` - Token-efficient structured output; requires a JSON Schema object to also be supplied
- JSON Schema object - Structured JSON output

A JSON Schema object cannot be combined with `"markdown"` or `"pdf"`. `"toon"` requires a JSON Schema object.

metadata.description: Arbitrary key-value metadata to attach to the task.

mcp_servers.description: MCP servers to provide additional tools during research. Max 5.

code_execution.description: Deprecated: use tools.code_execution instead. Enable code execution capability.

tools.description: Controls which optional tools the research agent can use. Each tool accepts an object with `enabled` (boolean, default true) and optional `max_calls` (integer, capped at system default).

max_calls.description: Max invocations per task. Capped at system default (10).

code_execution.description: Enable code execution in a sandboxed Python environment. System default max_calls: 10.

WorkflowOutputFormats.description:
Output formats the workflow produces. Items are the strings `"markdown"`, `"pdf"`, or `"toon"`, and/or a single JSON Schema object for structured output. Rules: at most one JSON Schema object; a JSON Schema object cannot be combined with `"markdown"` or `"pdf"`; `"toon"` requires a JSON Schema object. An invalid combination returns `400 invalid_output_formats`.

At run time, a task created with `workflow_id` inherits the workflow's `output_formats` when the request does not pass its own; a request-level `output_formats` always wins.

Workflow.description:
A workflow: templated, versioned DeepResearch. Valyu-curated workflows (`is_valyu: true`) are read-only.

List rows carry the discovery and template fields below. When fetching a single workflow (`GET /v1/workflows/{slug}`), creating, or updating, the response also includes the resolved version body - `prompt`, `strategy`, `report_format`, `tools`, `changelog`, and `output_formats`. On list, those version-body fields are included only when `?expand=true`.

WorkflowBadRequest.description:
The workflow request was invalid. The `error` field carries a machine-readable code and `message` a human-readable explanation.

Common codes:
- `changelog_required` - a changelog is required when publishing a new version
- `unreferenced_template_vars` - a declared variable is not used in the prompt template, or the template references an unknown variable
- `invalid_output_formats` - `output_formats` contained more than one JSON schema, mixed a schema with `markdown`/`pdf`, or used `toon` without a schema
- `field_too_long` - a text field exceeds its limit (64 KB)
- `too_many_variables` - more than 50 variables
- `too_many_deliverables` - more than 20 deliverables
- `workflow_and_freeform_mutually_exclusive` - workflow and freeform fields were both supplied (on the DeepResearch create endpoint)

value.message: A changelog is required when publishing a new version.
A declared variable is not used in the prompt template, or the template references an unknown variable.
output_formats may contain at most one JSON schema, which cannot be combined with markdown or pdf; toon requires a schema.

Common codes:
- `cannot_edit_valyu_workflow` - curated Valyu workflows are read-only
- `cannot_delete_valyu_workflow` - curated Valyu workflows cannot be deleted
